name: ai-fix-runner
description: Local AI Fix Runner — Test 1 of a coding-agent benchmark. Designed so the runner can later be swapped for Tensorlake Sandbox.

scripts.dev: pnpm run setup:native && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "pnpm run dev:api" "pnpm run dev:web"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter ./packages/shared run build && pnpm --filter ./apps/api run build && pnpm --filter ./apps/web run build
scripts.test: pnpm run setup:native && pnpm --filter ./packages/shared run --if-present test && pnpm --filter ./apps/api run test
